scope: Development planning only; no application, backend or frozen contract changes.

phases.title: Align contracts and establish foundations
phases.outcome: One reconciled contract baseline, documented repo gaps, secure persistence and test harness.
phases.entry: BRD revision 9 and local repository snapshot available.
phases.exit: DEV-001 to DEV-006 and DEV-057 accepted; contract proposals and unresolved commercial policies recorded; no frozen contract edited without owner merge.

phases.title: Deliver purpose based planning
phases.outcome: Six combinable purpose journeys, minimum-input interpretation, smart list plus chat, comparable mock offers and reviewed enquiry handoff.
phases.entry: P0 schema/access foundations; mock catalog fixtures.
phases.exit: A mixed family/rest request produces valid options; chips and chat match; both scope skips work; no model-invented price or automatic booking.

phases.title: Connect organization enquiries and commercial operations
phases.outcome: Corporate/MICE and education RFQs, first-party leads, versioned customer proposals, organizer decisions and partner catalog.
phases.entry: Accepted TripContext/cart and common API contracts.
phases.exit: Each of ten journey classifications can reach a qualified, priced, versioned proposal with an authorized organizer decision; Gate R1 evidence ready.

phases.title: Connect partner fulfillment and shared administration
phases.outcome: Dated availability, explicit allocations, manual/instant response engine, component ledger, amendments and shared staff views.
phases.entry: Current-version acceptance, scoped partner products and rates.
phases.exit: Rehearsal proves no over-allocation or duplicate reservation, partial status honesty, explicit release/reconfirmation and separate occasion proposal. MVP-A planning/RFQ pilot gate passes.

phases.title: Certify live supply and transactional checkout
phases.outcome: Contracted GDS/direct integrations, real revalidation, payment/refund evidence, supplier timeout recovery and release operations.
phases.entry: MVP-A accepted; supplier sandbox access and commercial/payment model resolved.
phases.exit: Gate R2 passes supplier certification, money/fulfillment tests, tenant security, backup restore and staffed exception rehearsals. Paid booking enabled only for supported capabilities.

phases.title: Expand journeys and optimize operations
phases.outcome: Advanced multi-leg and sequential-stay UI, group invite/discount tooling, richer organization rules and optional pooled supply.
phases.entry: Stable supported transactional pilot and product prioritization.
phases.exit: Each feature passes its own contract, consent, coverage and regression criteria; merchant pooling remains separately gated.

modules.title: Contract and configuration alignment
modules.planned: Owner-approved contract extensions and documented policy reconciliation

modules.title: Shared backend access persistence and events
modules.planned: Backend implementation in separately obtained elatetrips-node checkout; no backend directory in this frontend snapshot

modules.title: Trip intent and six purpose journeys
modules.planned: Shared TripContext contract and purpose preference reducers; selected planner entry route

modules.title: Offer search ranking and smart workspace
modules.planned: Normalized offer/search adapter contract and split results/chat workspace

modules.title: Component selection coverage and RFQ handoff
modules.planned: Coverage-aware component cart and explicit independent travel/stay scope

modules.title: Corporate MICE and education entry points
modules.planned: Proposed /corporate and /education routes; organization context and RFQ extension

modules.title: Lead intake and sales desk
modules.planned: Customer lead pipeline ownership and source attribution; optional /sales alias only

modules.title: Customer proposals revisions and approval
modules.planned: Separate customer proposal/version/approval entities linked to existing supplier quote IDs

modules.title: Partner account listings amenities and rates
modules.planned: Proposed /partner/portal workspace; product/rate revisions with authenticated partner membership

modules.title: Inventory allocation and component booking ledger
modules.planned: Internal dated allocations and pre-payment component task model without pooled merchant promises

modules.title: Common admin recovery and readiness
modules.planned: Common projections and role rules, preserving separate partner recruitment administration

modules.title: Group interest and separate occasions
modules.planned: Group-interest/invite records and parent-linked post-confirmation arrangement proposals

modules.title: GDS bus and direct supplier integrations
modules.planned: Capability adapters in shared backend; supplier-specific SDKs/keys never in web bundle

modules.title: Checkout financial state and aftercare
modules.planned: Accepted cart/proposal bridge, verified gateway events and policy-driven compensations

modules.title: Quality migration and release evidence
modules.planned: Approved gate checklist, parity/e2e/concurrency/security tests and migration evidence

modules.title: Advanced segments stays and organization features
modules.planned: Advanced segment/sequence UI and optional policy-based optimizations

tasks.title: Capture a reproducible repository baseline
tasks.deliverable: Record commit, route/module ownership, package scripts, actual fixture/live seams and existing failures before estimating remaining work.
acceptance: Given a clean checkout, documented contract/typecheck/lint/test/build commands produce retained results with each pre-existing failure identified.
File presence is distinguished from implemented behavior; missing backend and review-gates.md are recorded, not assumed complete.

tasks.title: Reconcile the new BRD with legacy contracts
tasks.deliverable: Create a requirement-to-contract delta register, entity glossary and current contract version decision. Identify old constitution/CHANGES text and reserved delta numbers.
acceptance: Every BRD9.BR-01 through BR-35 is mapped to a task and contract decision; no field is silently dropped.
SupplierQuote and CustomerProposal are distinct; event naming, inventory dependency and merchant auto-confirm semantics have an explicit resolution.

tasks.title: Prepare owner mergeable contract proposals
tasks.deliverable: Draft compatible intent/context, offer, organization/lead/proposal, partner inventory and booking/payment event changes with fixtures and migrations. Reserve next unused delta IDs; leave /contracts unchanged until owner merges.
acceptance: A proposal states affected modules, old/new payload examples, backward compatibility and migration tests.
Consumer/provider schemas and event/API additions validate against the owner-approved target version before dependent integration starts.

tasks.title: Externalize policies and release flags
tasks.deliverable: Define versioned configuration for purpose prompts, scoring, validity, SLAs, partner modes, group tiers, taxes/fees and supplier/payment capabilities.
acceptance: Changing a configured policy changes deterministic fixture output without engine code edits.
Missing commercial rules disable the affected live action and explain the reason; no old 008 thresholds or refund guarantees are copied as constants.

tasks.title: Establish server identity and resource scope
tasks.deliverable: Inventory existing JWT/OTP/membership behavior in the authorized backend checkout; implement validated customer, organizer, sales, ops, admin and partner scopes.
acceptance: Cross-customer, cross-organization and cross-partner queries/mutations return a typed denial.
A recipient-bound partner link cannot grant broader portal access; existing money-affecting OTP checks remain until changed through governance.

tasks.title: Persist canonical records and immutable audit
tasks.deliverable: Implement central versioned contexts/leads/proposals/products/bookings and audit persistence; verify database transaction support and indexes.
acceptance: Refreshing in another authorized session reads the same server record, while another tenant cannot read it.
State mutation and its audit/outbox record commit together where applicable; stale revisions fail instead of overwriting newer work.

tasks.title: Wire fixture and live service ports
tasks.deliverable: Extend the existing contract/agent/RFQ API slices through documented adapters. Keep catalog, RFQ and recommendation state joined by canonical IDs.
acceptance: The same accepted scenario passes fixture and server adapter contract tests with equivalent payloads.
No second browser-only RFQ/cart becomes authoritative; loading, empty and typed failure states render in every boundary.

tasks.title: Add idempotent commands and event projections
tasks.deliverable: Use idempotency keys, payload hashes, optimistic revisions, outbox delivery and replay-safe projections for commercial and fulfillment actions.
acceptance: Retrying an identical command returns its prior result; the same key with different intent is rejected.
Duplicate/out-of-order provider events cannot regress state or duplicate a confirmation; source and receive times remain distinct.

tasks.title: Introduce the accepted TripContext seam
tasks.deliverable: Version purposes, origin/destination, dates, party, preferences and scope while retaining adapters to the current RFQ and itinerary contracts. Include future segment IDs without shipping advanced UI.
acceptance: Unknown values remain null; explicit user facts and model proposals retain provenance.
A route/date/party change creates a reviewed context revision and invalidates stale search assumptions without silently changing selected services.

tasks.title: Build minimal purpose first entry
tasks.deliverable: Revise the selected existing /plan or /trip entry using current tokens; show essentials on every device and offer six purpose chips with a one-sentence search.
acceptance: Six purposes support multi-select; corporate and education are absent from the consumer purpose list.
Essentials are visible at mobile and desktop sizes; own travel/stay controls are reachable without a long planning form or voice input.

tasks.title: Extend the existing recommendation loop
tasks.deliverable: Reuse 007 extraction/tool-result ledger/serializer with validated purpose and filter actions, context version guards and a server-side model gateway.
acceptance: Known facts are not re-asked; ambiguous year, budget basis or place triggers one relevant clarification.
Untooled price/availability/product IDs, invalid output and injected supplier instructions cannot enter a result or invoke booking/payment mutations.

tasks.title: Implement six distinct purpose preference flows
tasks.deliverable: Add separate reducers/questions for discovery, rest/wellness, family, celebrations, pilgrimage and group intent, composing them into one context.
acceptance: Each purpose fixture reaches its own relevant next step; mixed family/rest and pilgrimage/rest retain both preference sets.
Conflicts prompt a priority choice; protected rest time, occupancy and requested visit timing are not overwritten by another purpose.

tasks.title: Define normalized supply capabilities
tasks.deliverable: Add common offer/search/revalidate/status ports with product, rate-plan, policy, currency, scope, coverage, observation and expiry references.
acceptance: Flight, bus, stay, experience and bundled mock offers validate against the approved schema.
An adapter explicitly declares unsupported capabilities; expired or unverified offers cannot be labeled bookable.

tasks.title: Build representative mock supply cases
tasks.deliverable: Provide route/date/party fixtures for flight/bus with local cab optional, separate stays, bus packages and complete private packages; include missing coverage, repricing, timeout and unavailable outcomes.
acceptance: For a supported fixture the list includes separate and package alternatives with consistent total/average-per-person amounts, exclusions and validity.
Unsupported routes produce an honest empty/partial-source state; sample rates are labeled and never advertised as live.

tasks.title: Unify behavioral filters and deterministic ranking
tasks.deliverable: Reuse 007 scoring/tool logic for cheapest, shortest, best value and purpose fit over eligible normalized offers. Declare comparison basis and configurable weights.
acceptance: A chip and equivalent chat message produce the same filter state, eligible IDs and sort order.
Cheapest compares the same scope; shortest uses a declared duration; explanations expose key trade-offs without inventing inclusions.

tasks.title: Build the results and chatbot workspace
tasks.deliverable: Compose existing agent, itinerary and catalog components with results left/chat right and results above/chat below on mobile.
acceptance: User sees current filters, comparable offer details and selected-but-hidden notices while chatting.
Keyboard, focus, loading/error/empty states and layout checks pass at 390, 768 and 1440 px; changing layout preserves selections.

tasks.title: Create coverage aware component selection
tasks.deliverable: Extend existing itinerary/cart seams with supplier product/session coverage and package-inclusion deduplication.
acceptance: Selecting a private package with a transfer adds that transfer once; a different dated session remains a distinct item.
A locked item is retained; a proposed alternate requires explicit customer action and a valid supplier bundle rule.

tasks.title: Implement independent travel and stay skips
tasks.deliverable: Make intercity travel, accommodation and local transport separate scopes in selection and pricing.
acceptance: All four travel/stay inclusion combinations work; own travel retains a desired local cab and own stay retains experiences.
Affected components and totals are reviewed when scope changes; hidden selections are never silently purchased or discarded.

tasks.title: Validate timing occupancy and component totals
tasks.deliverable: Use deterministic arrival/departure buffers, room/participant rules, slot overlap checks and integer-minor-unit arithmetic.
acceptance: Infeasible check-in/return/slot fixtures are blocked with a reason and alternatives.
Room-nights, participant counts and shared services reconcile to the selected total; changing party invalidates dependent estimates for review.

tasks.title: Connect reviewed planning to RFQ submission
tasks.deliverable: Reuse RFQ APIs and review sentence with an immutable selected-plan snapshot and source reference. Capture minimum reply contact/permission separately from trip discovery.
acceptance: No lead/submission is created before explicit review and submit; retry is deduplicated.
Selected component totals and separate occasion budget survive the handoff; editing the carried brief prevents reuse of stale prices.

tasks.title: Extend organization party and package pricing
tasks.deliverable: Add organization lane, organizer authority, student/staff counts and explicit room/vehicle/day/venue pricing bases to common context and proposals.
acceptance: Student and staff counts reconcile to the total, and unknown staff counts are not invented as zero.
A headcount or date change recomputes quantities from declared assumptions and asks for review of inconsistent rooming or vehicle capacity.

tasks.title: Deliver corporate and MICE package entry
tasks.deliverable: Add proposed /corporate route using shared result/chat components with corporate travel and event package variants.
acceptance: Each lane shows sample total and per-person costs, inclusions/exclusions and estimated validity.
Chat can revise event days, rooming, AV, meals, travel or activities; corporate options never appear as extra consumer purposes.

tasks.title: Deliver education and institution vacation entry
tasks.deliverable: Add proposed /education route with learning and vacation packages and independently recorded institution requirements.
acceptance: Both lanes show explicit student/staff, room, coach, meal and activity assumptions plus total/average pricing.
Educational readiness/permissions are displayed as requirements for review, not inferred from a booking or presented as a universal compliance guarantee.

tasks.title: Join organization RFQs to common operations
tasks.deliverable: Save reviewed organization requests as deduplicated first-party enquiries carrying exact context, inclusions/exclusions and source snapshot.
acceptance: Corporate, MICE, learning and vacation requests all open in the same authorized commercial workbench.
Save/import does not imply supplier prices are verified or organizer acceptance exists; missing authority/contact blocks publication.

tasks.title: Add first party lead intake and deduplication
tasks.deliverable: Reuse /leads and current APIs, separating customer travel enquiries from existing partner recruitment/EOI leads.
acceptance: Website, assisted and organization submissions retain source/campaign, permission timestamp and original brief.
Retries use submission keys; a deliberate second enquiry from the same email is retained and does not overwrite the first.

tasks.title: Extend the existing sales desk
tasks.deliverable: Use /desk and /leads for journey/source/stage search, owner, follow-up and assigned next action; optional /sales routing alias only.
acceptance: New, qualified, quoted and closed/lost records can be filtered; overdue and unassigned leads are visible.
A follow-up note does not itself send an email/WhatsApp message; scoped staff cannot read another organization’s leads.

tasks.title: Qualify and convert to an internal proposal
tasks.deliverable: Verify organizer, route, dates, party, budget basis and source-price assumptions before creating a customer proposal.
acceptance: Conversion is idempotent and retains the source RFQ/cart snapshot; unknowns stay explicit.
Imported fixture prices remain internal estimates until reviewed; conversion does not create acceptance or reservations.

tasks.title: Project sales workload and response metrics
tasks.deliverable: Add source conversion, quoted pipeline, approval follow-ups and supplier attention from the shared commercial/booking event model.
acceptance: Quoted value is labeled separately from collected revenue; duplicate events do not inflate counts.
Partner changes and partial/failed confirmations surface with an assigned next action in sales and admin.

tasks.title: Separate customer proposals from supplier quotes
tasks.deliverable: Introduce immutable CustomerProposalVersion and Approval linked to existing SupplierQuote IDs, policy/version snapshots and accepted context hash.
acceptance: A supplier quote cannot be mistaken for customer acceptance; the two retain separate IDs, states and lineage.
Included item amounts sum in minor units and keep supplier/service basis, exclusions and validity; contract replay preserves legacy quotes.

tasks.title: Build the common commercial workbench
tasks.deliverable: Extend existing quote UI for draft line quantities/prices, included/bookable flags, supplier, terms, exclusions and revision reason; compare candidate partner rates.
acceptance: Saving a draft leaves the published version, supplier commitments and current approval unchanged.
Concurrent staff edits fail a stale draft revision check; preparing partner prices never silently updates a customer-approved amount.

tasks.title: Publish and obtain version specific organizer decisions
tasks.deliverable: Publish append-only proposals; serve authenticated, authorized organizer review and approve/request-change/decline commands.
acceptance: Stale/expired versions and unauthorized organizers cannot approve; changes/decline require a note and all decisions carry evidence.
Publishing v2 resets acceptance without changing v1; no supplier component confirms merely because a quote is approved.

tasks.title: Reconcile amendments and earlier commitments
tasks.deliverable: Version service/context changes and retain prior supplier references, requiring explicit release or reconfirmation before revised tasks.
acceptance: Removed or changed services keep their prior ledger until a verified outcome is recorded.
No new revision rebooks an old reservation automatically; stale confirmation events are reconciled and cannot silently confirm the new commercial scope.

tasks.title: Reuse partner onboarding and scoped links
tasks.deliverable: Keep /partners discovery/onboarding and /partner signed cards; add authenticated account membership for proposed /partner/portal without breaking existing links.
acceptance: A partner sees only its assigned resources; expired/renewed links remain recipient-bound and registration consent is retained.
A read-only card or role switch cannot grant rate-edit or money-affecting commit authority; required OTP actions remain enforced.

tasks.title: Manage bookable partner listings and amenities
tasks.deliverable: Add room/category and experience products with city, occupancy/eligibility, verified/declarative rating source, descriptions, inclusions/exclusions and active state.
acceptance: Hotel/resort/host users can update only their own listings; staff reads the same persisted revision.
Pausing blocks new requests without deleting existing bookings; property ratings/amenities are not fabricated or automatically promoted as verified.

tasks.title: Add effective dated partner rate revisions
tasks.deliverable: Reuse the existing ratecard seam, extending approved contracts for unit, dates, currency, taxes/fees, meal/policy basis and expected revision.
acceptance: Invalid/negative/non-finite amounts and stale edits are rejected with typed messages.
New rates appear as sales candidates while published customer prices and their accepted policy snapshots remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Manage dated availability and stop sell
tasks.deliverable: Implement lodging rooms per night and experience capacity per dated session, with source ownership and inventory revision.
acceptance: Check-out consumes no extra room-night; an experience session has a separate participant allotment.
Capacity cannot be reduced below confirmed units/active holds; stop-sell prevents new confirmations while retaining historical reservations.

tasks.title: Create the component booking state machine
tasks.deliverable: Extend fulfillment contracts to represent approved pre-payment requests, supplier responses and independent payment state, without reusing old post-payment confirmed flags ambiguously.
acceptance: One approved version produces one logical task per required bookable component; retry does not duplicate tasks.
One confirmed hotel/activity leaves the trip partial; all required current components must confirm for aggregate supplier-confirmed status.

tasks.title: Map approved services and allocate inventory atomically
tasks.deliverable: Require explicit product, dates/session and rooms/participants tied to approved commercial quantities; reserve internal dates and event state in one supported transaction.
acceptance: A room-night total cannot be mistaken for rooms; mismatched city, supplier, service dates or quantity is rejected.
Two concurrent attempts for the final unit yield at most one allocation; failed or pending requests consume no capacity unless an explicit supported hold exists.

tasks.title: Connect manual and instant partner responses
tasks.deliverable: Let owning partners or authorized call/chat staff confirm with reference/evidence, request details or decline. Instant runs only for supported fresh matching rates/capacity.
acceptance: Missing evidence, stop-sell, insufficient inventory, stale approval or unsupported instant capability prevents confirmation.
A rate difference requires explicit partner honor of the accepted amount or new customer acceptance; decline flags an action without reserving inventory.

tasks.title: Implement release and allocation transfer
tasks.deliverable: Record verified release reference/evidence and same-service reconfirmation with links to the older reservation.
acceptance: A repeated confirmation/release has one effect; no capacity is deducted or returned twice.
Identical-service reconfirmation transfers the allocation once; a changed service needs an explicit release/reallocation and a release does not imply a refund.

tasks.title: Join common request and fulfillment views
tasks.deliverable: Extend /ops/console and /admin with common ten-lane request filters, approval/booking state, partner status and component evidence.
acceptance: Personal, corporate, MICE, learning and vacation requests are visible through the same authorized record model.
A response recorded by partner or staff is reflected in both views; no copied dashboard state can contradict the component ledger.

tasks.title: Extend recovery for partial and unknown outcomes
tasks.deliverable: Reuse /ops/recovery and safe existing recovery primitives, adding status-unknown reconciliation before retry and explicit alternative acceptance.
acceptance: A timeout is unknown rather than confirmed/failed; no retry creates another external booking before status lookup.
Valid confirmed components retain their references while an exception is assigned; substitution cannot bypass customer consent or locked-service constraints.

tasks.title: Manage configuration and institution readiness
tasks.deliverable: Keep role/config administration in /admin, recruitment in /partners/admin and operational readiness with the trip; audit both.
acceptance: Disabling new enquiry intake does not remove old records; only permitted roles change configuration.
Institution permissions/rooming are separate from supplier confirmation and reset for review on a new commercial version.

tasks.title: Add in app response attention and delivery ports
tasks.deliverable: Persist partner/staff/customer attention events with acknowledgement and future delivery adapters; preserve contact permissions and existing follow-up history.
acceptance: A confirmation or failure creates one in-app attention record; reopening or replay does not resend it.
External email/WhatsApp/voice channels stay off unless separately enabled and authorized; customer voice assistant and social automation stay off.

tasks.title: Capture group interest without promising inventory
tasks.deliverable: Collect route, mode, purpose, target/group size, budget basis and package interest with explicit price/availability conditions.
acceptance: Interested and confirmed/paid travelers are separate counts; interest cannot reserve seats or trigger a discount.
The customer sees each sample package amount, inclusions/exclusions and the next assisted quote step.

tasks.title: Keep occasion intent and budget outside main totals
tasks.deliverable: Capture birthday/anniversary or another supported occasion brief without making an arrangement a compulsory entry step or main-trip payable line.
acceptance: A celebration plus leisure/family request keeps the main trip eligible while recording its separate budget.
Review shows main total and indicative occasion budget separately; no automatic arrangement booking or charge occurs.

tasks.title: Create separately accepted occasion proposals
tasks.deliverable: After an eligible main stay/package is supplier-confirmed, create a parent-linked arrangement proposal using the same commercial and supplier engines.
acceptance: Before eligible main confirmation the arrangement action is blocked; after it, repeated creation yields one child proposal.
The child starts unapproved and requires its own price acceptance and provider confirmation; main booking approval never authorizes its charge.

tasks.title: Add invitation sharing and verified discount tiers
tasks.deliverable: Create opt-in group invitations with privacy controls and supplier-configured thresholds, deadlines and price revisions.
acceptance: A user explicitly chooses to share a link; no automatic social post/message or participant identity exposure occurs.
A threshold uses the declared interested/accepted/paid basis and verified supplier terms; any changed payable total requires fresh acceptance.

tasks.title: Integrate contracted flight supply
tasks.deliverable: Implement a provider-specific backend adapter against the normalized search/revalidate/book/status contract, retaining baggage/fare/expiry and client references.
acceptance: Sandbox fixtures and provider cases cover reprice, unavailable fare, partial failure and timeout/status reconciliation.
No provider key enters the frontend; a timed-out booking is looked up before another mutation.
tasks.scope_condition: Required before this source/capability is enabled; not all three sources must launch together.

tasks.title: Integrate contracted bus supply
tasks.deliverable: Use a bus aggregator/direct operator adapter with route/service/seat identity and actual cancellation/status capabilities.
acceptance: Seat changes and unavailability are revalidated and require customer review where price or scope changes.
Bus coverage/capabilities are explicit; the application does not assume the flight GDS also provides buses.
tasks.scope_condition: Required before this source/capability is enabled; not all three sources must launch together.

tasks.title: Integrate hotel GDS and direct partner APIs
tasks.deliverable: Map external room/rate-plan identities and partner API events to the central catalog/booking ledger with signature and replay checks.
acceptance: Direct allotment remains distinct from externally owned inventory and cannot be double counted.
Manual and API events follow the same approved scope/amount/evidence rules; duplicate callbacks change no totals or inventory.
tasks.scope_condition: Required before this source/capability is enabled; not all three sources must launch together.

tasks.title: Certify adapter parity and reconciliation
tasks.deliverable: Run approved sandbox/certification scenarios for each provider and scheduled status checks with source deadlines, retry limits and exception ownership.
acceptance: Supported adapters pass the same contract suite and required provider certification; missing capabilities are disabled.
Stale rates, missing callbacks and capacity drift surface with correlation IDs and an assigned exception rather than a fabricated successful booking.
tasks.scope_condition: Complete and certify every adapter selected for launch; leave all unselected provider capabilities disabled.

tasks.title: Resolve and implement accepted scope and payment policy
tasks.deliverable: Bridge current quote checkout to an accepted cart/customer proposal version. Reconcile platform-held payment and policy snapshot timing with the constitution before enabling money.
acceptance: The exact item/amount/currency/policy version is revalidated and explicitly accepted before payment or paid supplier mutation.
Supplier amount, taxes/fees, markup/discount and payable reconcile; undefined commercial responsibilities keep checkout disabled.

tasks.title: Wire sandbox payments and verified financial events
tasks.deliverable: Reuse 004/Razorpay integration seams with server-side idempotency, signature checks and separate authorized/captured/failed financial state.
acceptance: Browser success alone cannot mark paid; only a valid gateway event advances the financial ledger.
Duplicate webhooks capture once; failure/cancel scenarios retain supplier commitments and enter recovery under the agreed policy.

tasks.title: Publish honest customer booking status and aftercare
tasks.deliverable: Join booking/status, voucher and follow-up views to supplier and payment ledgers with explicit pending/partial/unknown states.
acceptance: Consolidated review/status shows per-component suppliers, references, price and policy coverage without claiming an atomic external transaction.
A partial confirmation, payment state or readiness checklist alone cannot display full trip fulfillment.

tasks.title: Implement approved cancellation and refund recovery
tasks.deliverable: Reuse policy/refund domain primitives only after deciding which legacy 008 promises remain applicable; model requests, provider cancellation, inventory release and refund settlement separately.
acceptance: Refund amounts use the accepted policy snapshot, not the latest catalog; money-affecting staff actions follow required role/approval evidence.
No release or supplier failure automatically asserts a settled refund; pooling satisfaction/dead-man guarantees remain disabled unless separately approved.

tasks.title: Restore and extend the acceptance harness
tasks.deliverable: Keep existing schema replay/path-guard and domain tests; record missing gate docs and establish module-local contract and end-to-end fixtures.
acceptance: All required scripts exist and a reproducible baseline report records pass/fail without hiding existing failures.
New tests use canonical fixtures, not copied HTML localStorage structures, and prove approved contract-version compatibility.

tasks.title: Demonstrate the complete quote loop at R1
tasks.deliverable: Prepare the proposed R1 evidence pack: purpose planning, organization lanes, lead qualification, proposal revision, organizer decision and partner quote/link compatibility.
acceptance: All ten journey classifications traverse the reviewed quote loop with proper scope/authority and no inferred booking.
Contract/typecheck/lint/test and relevant e2e checks pass, including stale/expired approval and mixed-purpose scenarios; owner verifies the restored gate checklist.

tasks.title: Accept the planning and operations MVP-A pilot
tasks.deliverable: Run role/tenant, persisted cross-portal, final-unit concurrency, duplicate response, amendment, readiness and separate occasion rehearsals; publish supported capability flags and a rollback runbook.
acceptance: The core P0-priority MVP-A tasks and R1 evidence pass; unresolved optional items are explicit and disabled.
Public-facing paid booking remains disabled; the pilot accurately states supported planning/RFQ/manual-coordination capabilities and mock/live boundaries.

tasks.title: Accept transactional release at R2
tasks.deliverable: Produce certification, payment/refund, authorization, accessibility, observability, migration/restore and staffed incident evidence; release only the certified capability subset.
acceptance: Customer payment through supplier confirmation/partial-failure recovery is demonstrated with replay-safe financial and booking evidence.
Backup restore and feature-flag rollback preserve external reservation references; business owners confirm provider/commercial prerequisites and R2 checklist.

tasks.title: Expose multi destination and leg level customization
tasks.deliverable: Extend the segment-ready context UI to ordered legs with per-leg travel/stay skips, route transfers and itinerary coverage.
acceptance: An A-to-B-to-C fixture maintains chronological coverage and shows which segment each offer serves.
Changing one leg revalidates affected components and totals; unrelated accepted selections remain identified and no duplicate shared transfer is added.

tasks.title: Expose sequential hotel selection
tasks.deliverable: Allow more than one hotel category/property across non-overlapping night windows and destinations while keeping one party together.
acceptance: Hotel change fixtures cover each required night once, with correct exclusive check-out and transfer buffers.
Same-night splitting of the party across hotels is rejected as outside the agreed MVP; changed stay scope gets reprice/reacceptance.

tasks.title: Expand organization policy and rooming workflows
tasks.deliverable: Add richer corporate policy/approval and institution staff/rooming/event schedules using the same commercial engine.
acceptance: Role-specific policies can be configured without cloning the backend or introducing consumer purposes.
A policy/rooming change creates a reviewable revision and never resets historical supplier or institution evidence silently.

tasks.title: Reassess pooled supply and automated allocation
tasks.deliverable: Reuse 008 canonical/assignment engines only if the merchant promise, policy-gap responsibility and customer disclosure are explicitly approved for this product.
acceptance: Pooling stays off by default; component-confirmed trip status cannot inherit booking.auto_confirmed semantics.
Approved optional pooling uses configurable eligibility, capacity/freshness checks, floor equivalence, audited assignment and contractual refund rules with migration tests.

conditionalDependencyRule: DEV-052 requires all supplier adapter tasks selected for launch; unselected capabilities stay disabled.

priorities.P0: Release blocker for the release/capability in which it is scheduled
priorities.P1: High-priority improvement; not an MVP-A release blocker
priorities.P2: Later optimization requiring its own scope decision

sizes: S M L describe relative complexity only; no calendar estimate or completion status is implied.
